terms.definition: All points at the same distance from one center.
terms.function: The shape of wheels and orbits.
terms.whyItMatters: Circles describe everything round and rolling.

terms.definition: The segment from the center to the rim.
terms.whyItMatters: The radius is the one number that defines a circle's size.

terms.definition: The segment across the circle through the center.
terms.whyItMatters: Diameter is the usual way to measure wheels and pipes.

terms.definition: The distance around the rim, equal to π × diameter.
terms.function: π ≈ 3.14 is the same ratio for every circle.
terms.whyItMatters: Pi ties the round rim to straight measurement.
